lane: independent source review and bounded native verification

evidence: The collector retains allowlisted tool names, phases, coarse target classification, and booleans for fixture marker presence in completed results; snapshots omit call IDs, arguments, raw outputs, URLs, and marker values.
The runner samples fixture readability and URL, active tab identity, and per-run assigned-tab identity at terminal. Mid-turn identity sampling is diagnostic only and cannot alter the answer verdict.

The acceptance questions, required answer content, terminal classifier, and answer assertions are unchanged. Fixture reinsertion remains limited to the pre-send check; there is no reinsertion during tool execution.
The follow-up commit preserves a failed identity probe as null/unavailable, so instrumentation failure does not turn a valid answer into an acceptance failure.
limits: The target label assigned_tab_or_non_tab_tool is intrinsically ambiguous for tools without explicit tab_id. Terminal per-run assigned-tab storage and the completed page-read result marker provide the useful attribution when available.

Tool-boundary identity snapshots are sampled by the polling loop after timeline events arrive; they are not atomic observations at handler entry. Use completed result marker booleans and terminal assigned-tab data as stronger evidence.
verdict_b_source_quality.privacy_review: No raw page data, tool arguments/results, URLs, IDs, or marker values are emitted by the diagnostic snapshot/report projection.

evidence.observed: A fresh signed-out guest answered the opening question with the unpredictable article code and all three requested stages in order. After a real side-panel reload, the guest answered the follow-up with its unpredictable code and fixture heading. The completed context tool event contained all expected marker classes as booleans; terminal identity confirmed the assigned tab matched the fixture tab. Artifact hash remained unchanged.

verdict_a.limits: This is one successful native acceptance run against the frozen Store candidate. The diagnostic identifies the server tool as context and confirms result markers and terminal assigned-tab identity; it does not expose a per-tool explicit target ID.

resource_admission.native_attempt: guest-grounding-peer-native-20261001-001; admitted, healthy watch, child exit 0, final decision valid

open_items: The native report's fixture was reinstalled after panel reload before the follow-up question; the opening question used the already installed fixture without pre-send reinsertion.
The per-event identity probe is sampled by the runner poll; it should be read as diagnostic context, not an atomic tool-handler-entry trace.
